mentions.name: LuxaforPresence
mentions.description: A macOS app that detects when an active meeting is running in commonly used apps and turns on a LED "presence" light to show others that the user is on air. The current release candidate supports detecting Teams meetings and Slack huddles.
mentions.problem: People nearby have no way of knowing when the user is currently in a meeting or on a call.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on MacOS app that detects an active meeting in one of the commonly used apps and then turns on a LED "presence" light.  The purpose to let others know that you are "on air" at this moment.
